comments.body: Done in 189da7e9: 23 key-encoder cases under modifyOtherKeys 2 record today's pin. Six encode to nothing (Ctrl+[, Ctrl+Shift+A, F13, F20, F25, Help): a_2x2vbvFbn.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
vt-1.0.0 changes what keys encode to under modifyOtherKeys 2: Ctrl keys send `CSI 27;...` rather than C0 bytes, and F13-F25, keypad, Help and Alt+Escape change (#14144, #14145, #14146, #14508). Non-ASCII Alt prefixes, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Backspace and kitty release text change too (#13861). corpus's key-encoder.json has no match for `modify_other`, so these would pass unnoticed, and Claude Code runs with modifyOtherKeys 2 on.

Record cases at the current pin before the move, so the move shows them as a reviewed diff.
title: No key-encoder oracle covers modifyOtherKeys 2, and vt-1.0.0 changes its output
